content.title: Definition of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, mildly reduced ejection fraction and preserved ejection fraction

rows.HFpEF: Objective evidence of cardiac structural and/or functional abnormalities consistent with LV diastolic dysfunction/raised LV filling pressures, including raised natriuretic peptides

abbreviations.HFrEF: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
abbreviations.HFmrEF: Heart failure with mildly reduced ejection fraction
abbreviations.HFpEF: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction

notes.a: Signs may not be present in the early stages of HF (especially in HFpEF) and in optimally treated patients.
notes.b: For diagnosis of HFmrEF, presence of other evidence of structural heart disease (e.g. increased left atrial size, LV hypertrophy or echocardiographic measures of impaired LV filling) makes the diagnosis more likely.
notes.c: For diagnosis of HFpEF, greater number of abnormalities present increases likelihood. Patients with non-cardiovascular disease (e.g. anaemia, pulmonary, renal, thyroid, or hepatic disease) may have similar symptoms/signs but without cardiac dysfunction do not fulfil HF criteria; these pathologies can coexist and exacerbate HF.
